headline: Shell and Petro Gazz Announce Gasoline Increases and Diesel Cuts for 6 October; September Inflation Due the Same Day
seoTitle: Fuel Price Changes and September Inflation Due October 6
seoDescription: Shell and Petro Gazz posted mixed pump-price changes effective 6 a.m. on October 6. The PSA is scheduled to release September inflation the same day.
deck: For Shell and Petro Gazz, the company notices, not the earlier DOE estimate, set Tuesday's pump prices. September inflation figures were not yet out.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What changed
paragraphs: Fuel retailers began posting mixed pump-price adjustments on Monday, October 5, for effect at 6 a.m. on Tuesday, October 6. According to GMA News, Shell Pilipinas said gasoline will rise by ₱1.90 per liter, diesel will fall by ₱1.30, and kerosene will rise by ₱3.30. Petro Gazz posted gasoline up ₱1.93 and diesel down ₱1.30. Inquirer separately reported the Shell figures. Other oil firms had not yet announced when those reports were published.

Earlier, on October 2, the Department of Energy had estimated a possible ₱1 per liter diesel cut and increases of about ₱1.50 for gasoline and ₱2 for kerosene, based on the first four days of global trading. Company notices, not that estimate, set the pump prices for the firms that have posted.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Last week, firms rolled back diesel by about ₱7.57 per liter, gasoline by at least ₱0.24 and kerosene by about ₱5.85, according to GMA's summary of prior adjustments.

Separately, the Philippine Statistics Authority is scheduled to release September inflation on Tuesday, October 6. A BusinessWorld poll of 22 analysts found a median forecast of 6.7%, up from 6.1% in August. A Philippine STAR poll of 13 economists also had a median of 6.7%, with forecasts from 6.3% to 7.0%. The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas has projected a 6.4% to 7.4% range for September. These are analyst and BSP forecasts, not the PSA result.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: At Shell and Petro Gazz, gasoline goes up on Tuesday and diesel comes down by less than last week's rollback. Shell's kerosene price also rises.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Tuesday's PSA release will show whether September inflation came in near the 6.7% median forecast.
